purpose: Build an unevaluated predicate record linking a latent-capacity subject, opaque measure token, and nonzero relation.

required.statement: Preserve subject, source identity, opaque measure and relation tokens, trace, nine unresolved identifiers, unresolved evaluation and identity statuses, and TLC-EA-HUIT-012-001.
Return an immutable deterministic NonzeroLatencyMeasureClaim predicate record, not a number or boolean.

forbidden.statement: Do not define units, codomain, numeric zero, comparison semantics, truth value, or measure evaluation.
Do not mutate input, resolve boundary or identity, or publish partial success.

deferred.statement: Measure type, signature, units, codomain, order, aggregation, numerics, truth, oracle semantics, boundary, and identity remain unresolved.
Concrete runtime representation and resource choices remain implementation-defined.

operations.purpose: Validate and preserve the subject, opaque measure token, and opaque nonzero relation.

constraints.statement: Numeric values, units, codomain, and requested truth evaluation are absent.
The output preserves subject, measure, relation, trace, unresolved set, and assumption without a numeric or boolean result.

preconditions.statement: The claim, subject, opaque measure and relation tokens, trace, reservations, and assumption are present.
No units, codomain, numeric comparison, zero semantics, or truth-evaluation request is present.

postconditions.statement: The predicate record preserves subject, measure token, relation token, and complete provenance.
Evaluation, boundary, identity, and all nine reservations remain unresolved; no number or boolean is returned.

invariants.statement: Source identity, subject, opaque tokens, trace, unresolved set, assumption, and limited status remain unchanged.
The result remains an unevaluated predicate record and no external state is modified.

steps: validate claim tokens trace and reservations

partial_order.before: validate claim tokens trace and reservations

prescription_basis: Observable predicate fields and unresolved preservation constrain publication; no comparison or unique total algorithm is prescribed.

error_contract.condition: Schema-compatible public alias for authoritative source error FAIL-HUIT-012-MISSING-TRACE: the claim, identity, trace, reservation, or assumption is missing.
Schema-compatible public alias for authoritative source error FAIL-HUIT-012-OPERATION: units, codomain, numeric zero, comparison, or truth evaluation is supplied or requested.
Schema-compatible public alias for authoritative source error FAIL-HUIT-012-SCIENTIFIC-INVENTION: unstated measure or relation semantics are supplied.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose the preserved subject, measure token, relation token, and unresolved statuses.
Do not assign units, compare values, or return truth.
Internal architecture is free when observable obligations are satisfied.

global_invariants.statement: Source identity, opacity, unresolved evaluation and boundary status, immutability, and provenance cannot be weakened.
A structural predicate record never becomes a number, boolean, or evaluated measure claim.

notes: Conformance is structural and does not authorize measure evaluation or prescribe a language, serialization, or total internal algorithm.
